title: Understanding Polynomial Features
text: Adding polynomial features, such as degree $$3$$, increases the complexity of the model. This can lead to overfitting, where the model captures noise in the training data.

title: Effect on Variance
text: Increasing the degree of polynomial features generally increases the variance of the model. This means the model becomes more sensitive to fluctuations in the training data.

title: Effect on Bias
text: While increasing polynomial degree can reduce bias by fitting the training data more closely, it often leads to higher variance.

title: Evaluating the Statement
text: Given the increase in model complexity with degree $$3$$ polynomial features, does this increase variance?
